findings.fact: Native commandAutoConnect calls endEdit and repaintCanvas after per-source autoConnect/setEdgeUpdated.
findings.implication: A post-command snapshot is a distinct observation boundary from producer return.

findings.fact: CECompletePack.repaintCanvas delegates to CEUpdateManager; its per-view callback uses util/aD.c(Function0).
findings.implication: Repaint-related event dispatch cannot be assumed to occur only after the driver EDT task completes.

findings.fact: util/aD.c invokes Function0 directly on EDT; the captured T callback calls CEViewContext.onInputEvent. CEUpdateManager also schedules a delayed callback using util/aD.a(long,String,boolean,Function0).
findings.implication: Review synchronous per-view processing and delayed work before asserting output stability around command return.

findings.fact: ACEditMode.endEdit calls virtual captureOptionalState, undo-manager addEdit, optional Function1, and modification bookkeeping.
findings.implication: The member list alone does not prove that all transitively invoked code preserves the output arrays.
